scoring_justification: Recompute success rate (fraction of 30 candidates with actual band gap in 0.9-1.7 eV) from the raw CSV rows; compare against paper-reported thresholds with direction-aware scoring (higher is better).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold success-rate thresholds for single global model and hierarchical partitioned model, plus relative improvement condition.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper Figure 1 description: "single global model raises this to approximately 46%" and "composite model with partitioning achieves approximately 67%".
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text; thresholds set at 0.46 and 0.67 respectively, with floating-point slack for threshold_or_better scoring.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly stated in the paper; no additional synthetic data needed.

outputs.description: Selected candidates from the single global model. The verifier recomputes the fraction of rows where actual_band_gap is between 0.9 and 1.7 eV and compares it against a hidden threshold.
Selected candidates from the hierarchical partitioned model. The verifier recomputes the fraction of rows where actual_band_gap is between 0.9 and 1.7 eV and compares it against a hidden threshold.

output_contract.notes: The checker independently counts compounds with actual band gap in the target range (0.9–1.7 eV) for each output file and scores the success rates against the paper's reported performance thresholds using a threshold_or_better policy.
